hypotheses.name: MOSAIC Capsule
hypotheses.claim: The correct cross-plane unit is an operation-specific identity capsule, not a universal global snapshot or one physical database.

hypotheses.name: Four-Axis Identity
hypotheses.claim: Every consequential handoff distinguishes executable semantic identity, exact contract/provenance instance, representation/view identity and causal basis/epoch identity.

hypotheses.name: Typed Collection Canonicalization
hypotheses.claim: Semantic hashing/canonicalization is defined by explicit collection algebra (SET/ORDERED/MULTISET/WEIGHTED), never container syntax alone.

hypotheses.name: Logical-Unified Physical-Polyglot DB
hypotheses.claim: UnifiedDB should initially be one typed logical query/transaction plane compiled onto specialized physical stores/indexes; physical consolidation is optional and workload-gated.

hypotheses.name: Subplan Placement
hypotheses.claim: Query operators should be placed/transformed per subplan using cost, consistency, locality and recovery risk rather than choosing one engine globally.

hypotheses.name: Derivation Receipt
hypotheses.claim: Every derived graph/vector/FTS/materialized view used causally carries source semantic/instance hashes, derivation/query-plan identity, basis epoch and bounded-lag/freshness status.

hypotheses.name: Selection as Read Dependency
hypotheses.claim: When candidate membership/ranking can change a result, selector/query-plan identity and authorized candidate-space lineage are part of the COVE causal slice.

hypotheses.name: Scoped Cognitive Transaction
hypotheses.claim: Cross-store commit/revalidation covers only operation-required consistency domains plus effect/capability dependencies; unknown scope broadens or escalates.

hypotheses.name: Incremental Cognitive Dataflow
hypotheses.claim: Canonical events update derived Clay views through dependency-scoped delta propagation, with adaptive rebuild when connectivity/read economics cross a measured threshold.

hypotheses.name: Zero-Copy Physical Carrier
hypotheses.claim: Hot Clay payloads should use typed shared-buffer/zero-copy carriers where target profiling proves benefit, while semantic/authority identity stays in compact receipts/handles.

hypotheses.name: MRSC After COVE
hypotheses.claim: Rail/view planning begins only after the trusted operation-specific semantic slice is compiled; a rail planner may compress/reformat but cannot enlarge or silently drop effect-critical closure.

hypotheses.name: Latent Reconciliation Gate
hypotheses.claim: P3/latent cognition may carry functional information but all durable truth/effect-bound outputs return as canonical proposals with semantic/role/anchor reconciliation.

hypotheses.name: Memory View Orthogonality
hypotheses.claim: Fast event memory, semantic graph memory, vector/FTS indexes, activation field and GWT candidate state are coordinated views with separate lifecycles, not one mutable truth blob.

hypotheses.name: Workspace Basis Capsule
hypotheses.claim: GWT intervention arms must pin or independently randomize MOSAIC basis, selector, projection/rail and re-entry identities before attributing a workspace effect.

hypotheses.name: Emergence Basis Receipt
hypotheses.claim: PEID/PID/TE/lesion/rescue measurements should store the exact MOSAIC identity capsule for every intervention so macro claims are replayable and stage-orthogonal.

hypotheses.name: Hard Isolation Exceptions
hypotheses.claim: Capability issuer/gateway, secret stores and high-blast-radius external effects remain physically isolated even under UnifiedDB logical semantics unless explicit fault/recovery evidence supports colocation.

hypotheses.name: Portable Semantics Variable Physics
hypotheses.claim: Linux/Android may use different DB/index/IPC/model runtimes and quantization but must expose the same canonical Clay identities and operation contracts; reader/platform identity is explicit.

hypotheses.name: Rebuildable Derived Cognition
hypotheses.claim: Crash recovery replays canonical event/contract state and deterministically rebuilds derived query/graph/vector/activation views; any derived state that cannot be rebuilt must explicitly declare independent authority and recovery semantics.
